_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): خَلَقَ اللّهُ الماءَ طَهورا لا يُنَجِّسُهُ شَيءٌ، إلّا ما غَيَّرَ لَونَهُ أو طَعمَهُ أو رِيحَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Allah has created water to be a purifier where nothing can make it impure, except for that water whose colour, taste or smell has changed.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ ما أشرَقَت علَيهِ الشَّمسُ فهُو طاهِرٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Everything that the sun shines on becomes purified.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّهَ عَزَّوجلَّ جَعَلَ التُّرابَ طَهوراً كما جَعَلَ الماءَ طَهوراً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah, Mighty and Exalted, made the earth a purifier just as he made water a purifier.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لمّا سُئلَ عنِ الجِصِّ يُوقَدُ عَلَيهِ بِالعذَرَةِ وعِظامِ المَوتى ثُمَّ يُجَصَّصُ بِهِ المَسجِدُ ، أيُسجَدُ عَلَيهِ ؟ ـ: إنَّ الماءَ وَالنّارَ قَد طَهَّراهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) was once asked about gypsum that is burnt along with dried excrement and bone ash, and then used to plaster a mosque, and whether prostration on such plaster is allowed. He replied, ‘Verily water and fire [from the kilning process] have purified it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فَرَضَ اللّهُ الإيمانَ تَطهيراً مِن الشِّركِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Allah has obligated faith in order to purify one from polytheism.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ تَقوَى اللّهِ دَواءُ داءِ قُلوبِكُم ... وطَهُورُ دَنَسِ أنفُسِكُم .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily being wary of ones duty to Allah is the remedy for the disease of your hearts … and the purifier of the pollution in your souls.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إن كُنتُم لا مَحالَةَ مُتَطَهِّرِينَ فَتَطَهَّرُوا مِن دَنَسِ العُيوبِ والذُّنوبِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Since you have no choice but to purify your bodies, then make a point of purifying yourselves of your faults and your sins.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ الرجُلَ إذا سَقَى امرَأتَهُ الماءَ اُجِرَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If a man quenches his wife's thirst he is rewarded for it.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا كَثُرَت ذُنوبُكَ فاسْقِ الماءَ عَلَى الماءِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If you have committed many sins, then quench peoples thirst time after time.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن سَقى مُؤمناً مِن ظَمَأٍ سَقاهُ اللّهُ مِنَ الرَّحيقِ المَختومِ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, 'Whoever quenches a believer of his thirst, Allah will quench him from the pure sealed wine [of Paradise].

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن سَقى ظَمآنا ماءً سَقاهُ اللّهُ مِنَ الرَّحيقِ المَختومِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ''Whoever gives a drink of water to a thirsty person, Allah will quench him from the pure sealed wine [of Paradise].

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ أوَّلَ ما يُبدَأُ بهِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ صَدَقةُ الماءِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Verily the first thing to be rewarded on the Day of Resurrection will be the giving of water.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ الصَّدقَةِ إبرادُ الكَبِدِ الحَرّى ، ومَن سَقى كَبِدا حَرّى مِن بَهيمَةٍ أو غَيرِها أظَلَّهُ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ يَومَ لا ظِلَّ إلّا ظِلُّهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'The best form of charity is to cool down someone's internal heat [by quenching them], and whoever quenches an animal's or any other being's internal heat, Allah will shade him on the Day when no shade will avail except His shade.

_source.chapter: The Duty of One Who Quenches Others
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لِيَشرَبْ ساقِي القَومِ آخِرَهُم .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The one who gives people to drink should himself drink last of all.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّما سُمِّيَ الرَّمَضانُ لأنّهُ يَرمَضُ الذُّنوبَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Verily Ramazan has been thus named because it scorches away sins.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ أبوابَ السماءِ تُفتَحُ في أوَّلِ ليلةٍ مِن شَهرِ رَمَضانَ، ولا تُغلَقُ إلى آخِرِ ليلةٍ مِنهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Verily the gates of the heavens are opened on the first night of the month of Ramazan, and are not closed again until the very last night.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لَو يَعلَمُ العَبدُ ما في رَمَضانَ لَوَدَّ أن يكونَ رَمَضانُ السَّنَةَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If the servant was to fathom the worth of Ramazan, he would wish that Ramazan lasted the whole year.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا استَهَلَّ رَمَضانُ غُلِّقَتْ أبوابُ النارِ ، وفُتِحَتْ أبوابُ الجِنانِ ، وصُفِّدَتِ الشَّياطينُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'As soon as the month of Ramazan sets in, the gates of Hell are locked up, the gates of Paradise are opened, and the devils are bound up.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ رسولَ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) خَطَبَنا ذاتَ يَومٍ، فقالَ: أيُّها الناسُ ، إنّهُ قد أقبَلَ إلَيكُم شَهرُ اللّهِ بالبَرَكَةِ والرّحمَةِ والمَغفِرةِ ، شَهرٌ هُو عِندَ اللّهِ أفضَلُ الشُّهورِ ، وأيّامُهُ أفضَلُ الأيّامِ ، ولَيالِيهِ أفضَلُ اللَّيالِي ، وساعاتُهُ أفضَلُ الساعاتِ ، هُو شَهرٌ دُعِيتُمْ فيهِ إلى ضِيافَةِ اللّهِ وجُعِلتُم فيهِ مِن أهلِ كَرامَةِ اللّهِ ، أنفاسُكُم فيهِ تَسبيحٌ ، ونَومُكُم فيهِ عِبادَةٌ ، وعَمَلُكُم فيهِ مَقبولٌ ، ودُعاؤكُم فيهِ مُستَجابٌ ... فَقُمتُ فقلتُ: يا رسولَ اللّهِ ، ما أفضَلُ الأعمالِ في هذا الشَّهرِ؟ فقالَ: يا أبا الحسنِ، أفضَلُ الأعمالِ في هذا الشَّهرِ، الوَرَعُ عن مَحارِمِ اللّهِ عزّوجلّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Verily the Prophet of Allah (AS) addressed us one day, saying, "O people, verily the month of Allah has come to you with benediction, mercy and forgiveness - a month that is the best of months in the sight of Allah, whose days are the best of days, whose nights are the best of nights, and whose hours are the best of hours. It is a month wherein you have been invited to the banquet of Allah and have been made worthy of Allah's magnanimity. Your breaths during this month are considered glorification [of Allah], and your sleep worship. Your actions in it are accepted and your supplication answered…" Upon hearing this, I stood up and asked, 'O Prophet of Allah, what is the best of deeds to be performed in this month?' He replied, 'O Abu al-Hasan, the best of deeds in this month is to restrain oneself from all that Allah, Mighty and Exalted, has prohibited.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقر (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قالَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) لَمّا حَضَرَ شَهرُ رَمَضانَ وذلكَ لثَلاثٍ بَقِينَ مِن شَعبانَ، قالَ لبِلالٍ: نادِ في الناسِ ، فَجَمعَ الناسُ ثُمّ صَعِدَ المِنبَرَ، فَحَمِدَ اللّهَ وأثنى علَيهِ، ثُمّ قالَ: أيُّها الناسَ ، إنَّ هذا الشَّهرَ قد حَضَرَكُم وهُو سَيِّدُ الشُّهُورِ ، فيهِ ليلةٌ خَيرٌ مِن ألفِ شَهرٍ ، تُغلَقُ فيهِ أبوابُ النِّيرانِ، وتُفتَحُ فيهِ أبوابُ الجِنانِ ، فَمَن أدرَكَهُ فلَم يُغفَرْ لهُ فَأبعَدَهُ اللّهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrated, 'At the end of Shaaban, when there were only three days left till the month of Ramazan, the Prophet (SAWA) told Bilal, 'Call all the people', so the people gathered together. The Prophet (SAWA) mounted the pulpit, praised Allah and glorified Him, then continued, 'O people, this month that is coming upon you is the chief of all months. One particular night in it is better than a thousand months. During this month, the gates of Hell are locked up, and the gates of Paradise are opened. So whoever, in spite of experiencing this month is not forgiven, has indeed been distanced by Allah.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ مِن وَصِيَّتِهِ لِولْدِهِ عِندَ دُخُولِ شَهرِ رَمَضانَ ـ: فاجهَدُوا أنفُسَكُم فإنّ فيهِ تُقسَمُ الأرزاقُ ، وتُكتَبُ الآجالُ ، وفيهِ يُكتَبُ وَفدُ اللّهِ الذين يَفِدُونَ إلَيهِ ، وفيهِ ليلةٌ العَمَلُ فيها خَيرٌ مِن العَمَلِ في ألفِ شَهرٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS), in his advice to his children heralding the advent of the month of Ramazan, said, 'Exert yourselves [in doing good deeds] for verily in this month sustenance is apportioned, life spans are destined, the names of Allah's select servants who wish to strive towards Him are recorded down, and in this month is a night wherein the good deeds performed equal the deeds of a thousand months.

_source.chapter: Allah's Forgiveness in the Month of Ramazan
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أدرَكَ شَهرَ رَمَضانَ فلَم يُغفَرْ لَهُ فَأبعَدَهُ اللّهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He who experiences the month of Ramazan and remains unforgiven has indeed been distanced by Allah.

_source.chapter: Allah's Forgiveness in the Month of Ramazan
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ في خُطبتِهِ عندَ إقبالِ شهرِ رمضانَ ـ إنّ الشَّقِيَّ مَن حُرِمَ غُفرانَ اللّهِ في هذا الشَّهرِ العَظيمِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA), in his sermon heralding the advent of the month of Ramazan, said, 'Verily the most unfortunate is he who is deprived of Allah's forgiveness in this great month.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:1, p. 295, number:53

_source.chapter: Allah's Forgiveness in the Month of Ramazan
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَنْ لم يُغفَرْ لَهُ في شَهرِ رمضانَ ففِي أيِّ شهرٍ يُغفَرُ لَهُ ؟!
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If a person remains unforgiven in the month of Ramazan, then what other month is there left for him to be forgiven in?!'

_source.chapter: Allah's Forgiveness in the Month of Ramazan
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن لَم يُغفَرْ لَهُ في شهرِ رمضانَ لَم يُغفَرْ لَهُ إلى مِثلِهِ مِن قابِلٍ إلّا أن يَشهَدَ عَرَفَةَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'If a person remains unforgiven in the month of Ramazan, he will not be forgiven in any other month after it unless he is able to attend the plains of AArafa [during the obligatory pilgrimage].

_source.arabic: عيسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا عَبيدَ الدنيا، تَحلِقُونَ رُؤوسَكُم وتُقَصِّرُونَ قُمُصَكُم وتُنَكِّسونَ رُؤوسَكُم ولا تَنزِعونَ الغِلَّ مِن قُلوبِكُم؟!
_source.english: Prophet Jesus (AS) said, ‘O slaves of this world, you shave your heads [claiming to be ascetics], you shorten your shirts, you bow your heads but do not remove the rancour from your hearts?!

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا لم تَغُلَّ اُمَّتي لم يَقُمْ لَها عَدُوٌّ أبَداً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘If it was not for the rancour that my community harbours, no enemy would ever challenge it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الغِلُّ بَذْرُ الشَّرِّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Rancour is the seed of evil.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الغِلُّ يُحبِطُ الحَسَناتِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Rancour thwarts good deeds.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أشَدُّ القُلوبِ غِلاًّ قَلبُ الحَقُودِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The heart that harbours the most rancour is the heart of the malicious person.

_source.chapter: That Which the Heart Cannot Harbour Rancour Towards
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) :ثلاثٌ لايَغُلُّ علَيهِنَّ قلبُ امرئٍ مسلمٍ: إخلاصُ العَمَلِ للّهِ، ومُناصَحَةُ وُلاةِ الأمرِ، ولزومُ جَماعَةِ المُسلمينَ ؛ فإنَّ دَعوَتَهُم تُحيطُ مِن وَراءِهِم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There are three things towards which the heart of a Muslim will not harbour rancour: the sincere act performed for Allah, the sincere advice of leaders, and adherence to the community of Muslims; for verily their attraction towards these things encompasses them from all sides.

_source.chapter: The One Who Breaches His Trust (out of Rancour)
_source.arabic: الدرّ المنثور عن ابنِ عبّاسٍ: نَزَلَت هذهِ الآيةُ: «وما كانَ لِنبيٍّ أنْ يَغُلَّ» في قَطيفَةٍ حَمراءَ افتُقِدَتْ يَومَ بَدرٍ، فقالَ بعضُ الناسِ: لَعَلَّ رسولَ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) أخَذَها! فَأنزَلَ اللهِ: «وما كانَ لِنبيٍّ أن يَغُلَّ».
_source.english: Ibn Aabbas narrated, ‘The verse: “A prophet may not breach his trust, and whoever breaches his trust will bring his breaches on the Day of Resurrection” was revealed with regards to a red velvet shawl that got lost on the day of the battle of Badr, so some people started saying that maybe the Prophet (SAWA) had taken it! So Allah revealed the verse: “A prophet may not breach his trust …”

_source.chapter: The One Who Breaches His Trust (out of Rancour)
_source.arabic: الترغيب والترهيب: لَمّا كانَ يومُ خَيبَرَ أقبَلَ نَفَرٌ مِن أصحابِ النبيِّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) فقالوا: فلانٌ شَهيدٌ، وفلانٌ شَهيدٌ، وفلانٌ شهيدٌ، حتّى مَرُّوا على رَجُلٍ فقالوا: فلانٌ شَهيدٌ، فقالَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): كَلاّ، إنّي رَأيتُهُ فِي النارِ في بُردَةٍ غَلَّها، أو عَباءَةٍ غَلَّها.
_source.english: Aumar narrated, ‘On the day of the battle of Khaybar, some of the Prophet (SAWA)s companions came to him, [listing who had been martyred], ‘x is a martyr, y is a martyr, etc… until they mentioned a particular man as having been martyred, upon which the Prophet (SAWA) exclaimed, ‘No way, verily I have seen him burning in the Fire, clad in a shawl or a cloak that he had taken [as a breach of trust of the war booty].
_source.cited_from: Al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib, volume:2, p. 307, number:4

_source.chapter: The One Who Breaches His Trust (out of Rancour)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الغُلولُ كُلُّ شيءٍ غُلَّ عن الإمامِ، وأكلُ مالِ اليَتيمِ شُبهَةً، والسُّحْتُ شُبهَةً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Breach of trust includes anything that is taken unlawfully from ones Imam [in the form of war booty before it has been justly divided], or usurping the property of an orphan, or consuming illicit gains.

_source.chapter: The Person with the Greatest Regret
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : إنَّ أشَدَّ النّاسِ نَدامَةً يَومَ القِيامَةِ ، رجُلٌ باعَ آخِرَتَهُ بدُنيا غَيرِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The person with the most intense remorse on the Day of Resurrection will be the man who sold his Hereafter for the world of others.

_source.chapter: The Person with the Greatest Regret
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ أعْظَمَ الحَسَراتِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ ، حَسْرَةُ رجُلٍ كَسَبَ مالاً في غَيرِ طاعَةِ اللّهِ ، فوَرِثَهُ رجُلٌ فأنْفَقَهُ في طاعةِ اللّهِ سُبحانَهُ ، فدَخَلَ بهِ الجَنّةَ ، ودَخَلَ الأوَّلُ بهِ النّارَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The greatest of regrets on the Day of Resurrection will be the regret of a man who gained wealth through means of disobedience Allah, which was then inherited by a man who spent it in the obedience of Allah, glory be to Him; thus because of it [i.e. the same wealth] the latter entered Paradise whereas the former entered the Fire.

_source.chapter: The Person with the Greatest Regret
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنّ أعظَمَ النّاسِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ (حَسْرَةً) مَن وَصفَ عَدْلاً ثُمَّ خالَفَهُ إلى غَيرِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The most regretful person on the Day of Resurrection will be the man who speaks of justice yet acts in opposition to it with others.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن دَقَّ في الدِّينِ نَظَرُهُ جَلَّ يومَ القِيامَةِ خَطَرُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever gives acute attention to their religion will have a lofty station on the Day of Resurrection.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدِّينُ نورٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Religion is light.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدِّينُ يَعصِمُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Religion immunizes.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدِّينُ أقوَى عِمادٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Religion is the strongest support.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ أميرُ المؤمنينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) كثيراً مّا يقولُ في خُطبتِهِ: يا أيّها الناسُ ، دِينَكُم دِينَكم !! فإنّ السيّئةَ فيهِ خيرٌ مِن الحَسَنةِ في غَيرِهِ ، والسيّئةَ فيهِ تُغفَرُ ، والحَسَنةَ في غيرِهِ لا تُقبَلُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The Commander of the Faithful (AS) would frequently say in his sermons, ‘O people! Preserve your religion, for the bad deed of a religious person is better than the good deed of a religion-less person, because the bad deed of a religious person can be forgiven but the good deed of a religion-less person is not even accepted.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): آفَةُ الدِّينِ سُوءُ الظنِّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The bane of religion is suspiciousness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فسادُ الدِّينِ الدنيا.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The corruption of religion lies in [the vanities of] this world.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): آفَةُ الدِّينِ: الحَسَدُ والعُجبُ والفَخرُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The bane of religion is in jealousy, self-conceit and pride.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا حَضَرَت بَلِيَّةٌ فاجعَلُوا أموالَكُم دونَ أنفسِكُم ، وإذا نَزَلَت نازلةٌ فاجعَلُوا أنفسَكُم دونَ دِينِكُم ، واعلَمُوا أنَّ الهالِكَ مَن هَلَكَ دِينُهُ ، والحَريبَ مَن حُرِبَ دِينُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘If you are faced with a tribulation, shield your life with your wealth. If you are faced with a calamity, then shield your religion with your life, and know that the ruined man is he who destroys his religion himself and that the corrupted one is he who spoils his religion himself.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ كانَ يقولُ عندَ المُصيبةِ ـ: الحمدُ للّهِ الذي لم يَجعَلْ مُصِيبَتِي في دِينِي.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) would say when struck with an affliction, ‘All praise be to Allah who did not allow my religion to be afflicted.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا دِينَ لِمَن دانَ بطاعةِ مَن عَصَى اللّهَ ، ولا دِينَ لِمَن دانَ بِفِريَةِ باطلٍ على اللّهِ ، ولا دِينَ لِمَن دانَ بجُحُودِ شَيءٍ مِن آياتِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘One who subjects himself to the obedience of someone who disobeys Allah has no religion, and the one who subjects himself to attributing a lie or falsity to Allah has no religion, and the one who subjects himself to denying any of Allahs signs has no religion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا دِينَ لِمَن دانَ بولايةِ إمامٍ جائرٍ لَيسَ مِنَ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who subjects himself to following an oppressive leader unendorsed by Allah has no religin.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لادِينَ لِمَن لاعَهدَ لَه .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The one who has no covenant has no religion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ مَن لم يُحِبَّ على الدِّينِ ولم يُبغِضْ على الدِّينِ فلا دينَ لَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Anyone whose love and hate is not based on religion, has no religion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا دِينَ لِمَن لامُرُوَّةَ لَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘He who has no valorous qualities has no religion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لادِينَ لِمَن لاوَرَعَ لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘He who has no piety has no religion.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يا أيّها الناسُ ، إنَّ دِينَ اللّهِ يُسرٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘O people, verily the religion of Allah is easy.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): بُعِثتُ بِالحَنِيفِيَّةِ السَّمْحَةِ ، ومَن خالَفَ سُنَّتِي فلَيسَ مِنّي.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘I have been sent [to you] with the upright and liberal religion and whoever defies my prophetic practice is not from me.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ اللّهَ لم يَبعَثْنِي بالرَّهبانِيَّةِ ، وإنّ خيرَ الدِينِ عندَ اللّهِ الحنيفيّةُ السَّمْحَةُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily Allah has not sent me with monasticism, rather the best religion with Allah is the upright and liberal one.

_source.chapter: The Only Religion Through Which Deeds are Accepted
_source.arabic: عن عليِّ بنِ أبي حمزَةَ عن أبي بصيرٍ، قال: سمعتُهُ يسألُ أبا عبدِ اللّهِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) فقالَ له: جُعِلتُ فِداكَ أخبِرْني عنِ الدِّينِ الذي افتَرَضَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ عَلى العبادِ ما لا يَسَعُهُم جَهلُهُ ، ولا يُقبَلُ مِنهُم غيرُهُ ماهو ؟ فقالَ: شهادةُ أن لا إلهَ إلّا اللّهُ ، وأنّ محمّداً رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ، وإقامُ الصلاةِ ، وإيتاءُ الزكاةِ ، وحجُّ البيتِ مَنِ استَطاعَ إلَيهِ سبيلاً ، وصومُ شَهرِ رمضانَ . ثُمّ سَكَتَ قليلاً ثُمّ قالَ: والوَلايةُ ـ مَرّتَينِ ـ .
_source.english: Abu Basir asked Imam al-Sadiq (AS), ‘May I be your ransom! Please inform me about the religion that Allah has obligated upon his servants, [the religion] that they cannot afford to be ignorant of and the only religion that will be accepted from them. What is it? The Imam (AS) replied, ‘Bearing witness that there is no god except Allah and that Muhammad (SAWA) is the messenger of Allah, establishing the prayer, paying the alms-tax, pilgrimage to the House for those who are able to do so, fasting the month of Ramadhan. Then the Imam momentarily paused and then repeated twice, ‘and divine guardianship [of the divinely appointed Imams] (al-walaya).
_source.chapter_ar: الدِّينُ الَّذي لا تُقبَلُ الأعمالُ إلّا بِهِ

_source.chapter: The Correct Way to Understanding Religion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن عَرَفَ دينَهُ مِن كتابِ اللّهِ عزّوجلّ زالَتِ الجِبالُ قبلَ أن يَزُولَ ، ومَن دَخَلَ في أمرٍ بِجَهلٍ خَرَجَ منهُ بِجَهلٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The one who understands his religion from the Book of Allah, mountains will move before he does [in his faith], and the one who enters a matter with ignorance [i.e. accepts religion ignorantly] will leave it in ignorance.

_source.chapter: The Correct Way to Understanding Religion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن دَخَلَ في هذا الدِّينِ بالرِّجالِ أخرَجَهُ مِنهُ الرِّجالُ كما أدخَلُوهُ فيهِ ، ومَن دَخَلَ فيهِ بِالكِتابِ والسُّنَّةِ زالَتِ الجبالُ قَبلَ أن يَزولَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The one who enters this religion through men will exit it through men just as they caused him to enter it. And whoever enters this religion through the Book and the prophetic practice, mountains will move before he does [in his faith].

_source.chapter: Protecting the Religion By Means of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): صُن دِينَكَ بدُنياكَ تَربَحْهُما ، ولا تَصُنْ دنياكَ بِدِينِكَ فَتَخسَرَهُما.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Protect your religion by means of your worldly affairs and you will profit in both, but do not use your religion to protect your worldly affairs as you will lose them both.

_source.chapter: Protecting the Religion By Means of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَترُكُ الناسُ شيئاً مِن دِينِهِم لِإصلاحِ دُنياهُم إلّا فَتَحَ اللّهُ عَليهِم ما هُوَ أضَرُّ مِنهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘No sooner do people omit any aspect of their religion for the sake of improving their worldly affairs than Allah will open for them something that will be more detrimental to them [than the improvement of their worldly affairs].

_source.chapter: Supplication for Affirming the Heart towards Religion
_source.arabic: عن عبد اللّه بن سنان: قال أبو عبد اللّه (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سَتُصيبُكُم شُبهَةٌ فَتَبقُونَ بِلا عَلَمٍ يُرى ولا إمامٍ هدى ، ولا يَنجُو مِنها إلّا مَن دَعا بدُعاءِ الغَريقِ. قلتُ: كيفَ دعاءُ الغَريقِ ؟ قالَ: يقولُ: «يا اللّهُ يا رحمنُ يا رحيمُ يا مُقَلِّبَ القُلوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلبِي على دِينِكَ» .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘You will be afflicted with an obscure matter that will leave you with no sign to indicate to the solution, nor a leader to guide the way. None shall be saved from it except the one who recites the ‘Supplication of the Drowning Person. [The narrator says] I asked the Imam, ‘What is the Supplication of the Drowning Person? The Imam replied, ‘O Allah, O the Beneficent, O the Merciful, O He who causes the hearts to fluctuate, affirm my heart upon Your religion.

_source.chapter: Characteristics of the Preservers of Allahs Religion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّما المُستَحفِظُونَ لِدِينِ اللّهِ هُمُ الذينَ أقامُوا الدِّينَ ونَصَرُوهُ ، وحاطُوهُ مِن جميعِ جَوانِبِهِ ، وحَفِظُوهُ على عِبادِ اللّهِ ورَعَوهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the preservers of Allahs religion are the same people who established the religion and helped it, they guarded it from all sides, they preserved it for the servants of Allah and carefully watched over it.

_source.chapter: The Strengthening of Religion through a Disgraceful People
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ اللّهَ لَيُؤَيِّدُ هذا الدِّينَ بالرَّجُلِ الفاجِرِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily Allah strengthens this religion through an oppressive man.
_source.chapter_ar: تَأييدُ الدِّينِ بِأقوامٍ لا خَلاقَ لَهُم

_source.chapter: The Strengthening of Religion through a Disgraceful People
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ اللّهَ تَبارَكَ وَتَعالى يُؤَيِّدُ هذا الدِّينَ بِأقوامٍ لا خَلاَقَ لَهُم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily Allah, Blessed and most High, strengthens this religion through a disgraceful people.
_source.chapter_ar: تَأييدُ الدِّينِ بِأقوامٍ لا خَلاقَ لَهُم

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ نبيّاً مِنَ الأنبياءِ مَرِضَ، فقالَ: لا أتَداوى حتّى يكونَ الذي أمرَضَنِي هُو الذي يَشفينِي ، فأوحَى اللّهُ تعالى إلَيهِ: لا أشفِيكَ حتّى تَتَداوى، فإنَّ الشِّفاءَ مِنّي.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘A prophet from among the prophets fell sick and said, ‘I will not treat myself [with medicine] until the One who made me sick heals me. Then Allah revealed to him saying, ‘I will not heal you until you treat yourself [with medicine] for verily the healing is from Me.

_source.chapter: There is a Cure for Every Ailment
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): تَداوَوا فإنَّ اللّهَ تعالى لَم يُنزِلْ داءً إلّا وقد أنزَلَ اللّهُ لَهُ شِفاءً ، إلّا السّامَ والهَرَمَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Treat yourselves with medicine, for verily Allah has not sent down any ailment except that he has sent down a cure for it with the exception of death and old age.

_source.chapter: There is a Cure for Every Ailment
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لِكُلِّ عِلّةٍ دَواءٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘For every ailment, there is a cure.

_source.chapter: Beware of Hastening towards Resorting to Medicine
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): تَجَنَّبِ الدَّواءَ ما احتَمَلَ بَدنُكَ الداءَ ، فإذا لم يَحتَمِلِ الداءَ فالدواءُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Avoid medicine as long as your body can bear the ailment, but if it cannot bear the ailment, then resort to medicine.

_source.chapter: Beware of Hastening towards Resorting to Medicine
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَتَداوَى المُسلمُ حتّى يَغلِبَ مَرَضُهُ صِحَّتَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A Muslim does not seek to treat himself [with medicine] until the ailment overcomes his health.

_source.chapter: Beware of Hastening towards Resorting to Medicine
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَيسَ مِن دواءٍ إلّا وهو يُهَيِّجُ داءً، وليسَ شيءٌ في البَدنِ أنفَعَ مِن إمساكِ اليدِ إلّا عمّا يَحتاجُ إلَيهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘There is no medicine except that it exacerbates another ailment, and there is nothing more beneficial to the body than self-restraint from all except that which the body needs.

_source.chapter: Diet Control is the Fountainhead of Remedies
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): التَّجوُّعُ أنفَعُ الدواءِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Starving out is the best of remedies.

_source.chapter: Diet Control is the Fountainhead of Remedies
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَضُرُّ المَريضَ ما حَمَيتَ عنهُ الطَّعامَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Dieting from food causes no harm to the sick person.

_source.chapter: Diet Control is the Fountainhead of Remedies
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَنفَعُ الحِميَةُ لمريضٍ بعدَ سبعَةِ أيّامٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘[Starting to] Diet from food is of no benefit to the sick person after seven days.

_source.chapter: Diet Control is the Fountainhead of Remedies
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الحِميةُ رأسُ الدواءِ ، والمَعِدةُ بيتُ الداءِ ، عَوِّدْ بَدَناً ما تَعَوّدَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Diet control is the fountainhead of remedies and the stomach is the house of all ailments, so condition your body while it can be conditioned.

_source.chapter: Diet Control is the Fountainhead of Remedies
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَيسَ الحِميةُ أن تَدَعَ الشيءَ أصلاً لاتَأكُلَهُ، ولكنَّ الحِميَةَ أن تَأكُلَ مِنَ الشيءِ وتُخَفِّفَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Diet control is not to avoid eating absolutely anything, rather diet control is to eat lightly.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): في طِينِ قبرِ الحسينِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) الشِّفاءُ مِن كلِّ داءٍ وهُوَ الدواءُ الأكبَرُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘In the soil of the grave of Husayn (AS) is a healing for every disease, for it is the greatest remedy.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ربّما كانَ الدَّواءُ داءً والدّاءُ دواءً .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘It is possible for a medicine to be an ailment and an ailment to be a medicine.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَصِفَنَّ لِمَلِكٍ دواءً ، فإن نَفَعَهُ لَم يَحمَدْكَ ، وإن ضَرَّهُ اتَّهَمَكَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, ‘Do not prescribe any remedy for a king, for if it benefits him, he will fail to show gratitude to you, and if it harms him he will accuse you.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of the Remembrance of Allah
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَختارَنَّ عَلى ذِكرِ اللّهِ شَيئاً فإنّهُ يقولُ: «وَلَذِكْرُ اللّهِ أكْبَرُ».
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Never prefer anything above the remembrance of Allah for verily He says, “and the remembrance of Allah is surely greater.”

_source.chapter: The Virtue of the Remembrance of Allah
_source.arabic: عن معاذ عنه (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لَيسَ عَمَلٌ أحَبَّ إلى اللّهِ تعالى ولا أنجى لِعَبدٍ مِن كُلِّ سيّئةٍ في الدنيا والآخِرَةِ مِن ذِكرِ اللّهِ . قيلَ: ولا القتالُ في سبيلِ اللّهِ ؟ قالَ: لولا ذِكرُ اللّهِ لم يُؤمَرْ بالقِتالِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There is no action more beloved to Allah Almighty, or more successful as a means of salvation for a servant of Allah from all the evil of this world and the next than the remembrance of Allah. Someone then asked, ‘Not even fighting in the way of Allah? The Prophet (SAWA) replied, ‘If it was not for the remembrance of Allah, there would be no command to fight in the way of Allah.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of the Remembrance of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الذِّكرُ لَذَّةُ المُحِبِّينَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Remembrance is a source of great pleasure for the lovers [of Allah].

_source.chapter: The Virtue of the Remembrance of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الذِّكرُ مُجالَسَةُ المَحبوبِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Remembrance is sitting in the company of the Beloved One.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of the Remembrance of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ذِكرُ اللّهِ سَجِيَّةُ كُلِّ مُحسِنٍ وشِيمَةُ كُلِّ مُؤمنٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Remembrance of Allah is the natural disposition of every good-doer and the distinguishing mark of every believer.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): عَليكَ بتِلاوَةِ القرآنِ وذِكرِ اللّهِ كثيراً ، فإنّهُ ذِكرٌ لكَ في السماءِ ونورٌ لكَ في الأرضِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘I urge you to recite the Quran and remember Allah frequently, for verily it [will result in] a remembrance for you in the heavens and a light for you in the earth.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن ذَكَرَ اللّهَ في السِرِّ فقد ذَكَرَ اللّهَ كثيراً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever remembers Allah in private, has surely remembered Allah much.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أكثِرُوا ذِكرَ اللّهِ ما استَطَعتُم في كُلِّ ساعةٍ مِن ساعاتِ الليلِ والنهارِ ، فإنَّ اللّهَ أمَرَ بكَثرَةِ الذِكرِ لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Remember Allah frequently as much as you can every hour of the day and night, for verily Allah has commanded [us] to remember Him abundantly.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَسبيحُ فاطمةَ الزهراءِ (عَلَيهَا الّسَلامُ) مِنَ الذِكرِ الكثيرِ الذي قالَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ: «اُذْكُرُوا اللّهَ ذِكْراً كثيراً» .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The glorification of Fatima al-Zahra [The glorification of Fatima al-Zahra (AS), otherwise known as Tasbih al-Zahra is composed of reciting Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greater) 34 times, Alhamdulillah (Praise be to Allah) 33 times and Subhanallah (Glory be to Allah) 33 times. Usually it is recommended to recite it after every obligatory prayer (ed.)] (AS) is from the frequent remembrance which Allah mentions, “Remember Allah with a frequent remembrance.”

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Engaging in Continuous Remembrance
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما مِن ساعةٍ تَمُرُّ بابنِ آدَمَ لَم يَذكُرِ اللّهَ فيها إلّا حَسِرَ علَيها يَومَ القيامَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Every single hour that passes by the son of Adam, that was devoid of the remembrance of Allah will be grieved for on the Day of Resurrection.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Engaging in Continuous Remembrance
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في المُناجاةِ الشَّعبانيّةِ ـ: إلهي، وألْهِمني وَلَهاً بِذِكرِكَ إلى ذِكرِكَ وهِمَّتي إلى روحِ نَجاحِ أسمائكَ ومَحَلِّ قُدسِكَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in the intimate supplication of the month of Shaban (Al-Munajat al-Shaabaniyya: the intimate supplication of the month of Shaaban recited by Imam Ali (AS) and the Imams from his progeny (AS) during the sacred month of Shaaban), ‘My God! Inspire me with fervour for Your remembrance until I have become inspired with Your remembrance, and a spiritual zeal for the refreshing salvation of Your Names and the place of Your sanctity.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Engaging in Continuous Remembrance
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أسأَلُكَ أن تُصَلِّيَ على محمّدٍ وآلِ محمّدٍ ، وأن تَجعَلَنِي مِمَّن يُدِيمُ ذِكرَكَ ، ولا يَنقُضُ عَهدَكَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘I ask You to send blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and to make me of those who are continuous in Your remembrance and who do not breach Your covenant.

_source.chapter: The Remembrance of Allah is Good at All Times
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ مِن وَصاياهُ لاِبنِهِ الحسنِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) عِندَ الوَفاةِ ـ: وكُن للّهِ ذاكِراً على كلِّ حالٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in counsel to his son Hasan at the time of his death (AS), ‘and be one to remember Allah at all times.
_source.chapter_ar: ذِكرُ اللّهِ حَسَنٌ عَلى كُلِّ حالٍ

_source.chapter: The Remembrance of Allah is Good at All Times
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قالَ موسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا ربِّ ، إنّي أكونُ في حالٍ اُجِلُّكَ أن أذكُرَكَ فيها . قالَ: يا موسى ، اُذكُرْني على كُلِّ حالٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrated, ‘Prophet Moses (AS) said, ‘My Lord, I am in a [base] state wherin I esteem You too highly to remember You therein, He said, ‘O Moses, remember Me at all times.
_source.chapter_ar: ذِكرُ اللّهِ حَسَنٌ عَلى كُلِّ حالٍ

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الذاكِرُ في الغافِلينَ كالمُقاتِلِ في الفارِّينَ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The one who remembers [Allah] in the midst of the neglectful ones is as one who fights [in the way of Allah] in the midst of others who flee [from the battle].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): كُلُّ أحَدٍ يَموتُ عَطْشانَ إلّا ذاكِرَ اللّهِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Everyone will die thirsty except the one who remembers Allah.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ موسى بنَ عِمرانَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) لَمّا ناجى رَبَّهُ عزّوجلّ قالَ: يا ربِّ ، أبَعيدٌ أنتَ مِنّي فَاُنادِيَكَ أمْ قَريبٌ فَاُناجِيَكَ ؟ فأَوحَى اللّهُ جلّ جلالُهُ: أنا جَلِيسُ مَن ذَكَرَني.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) narrated, ‘Verily when Moses, son of Amran (AS) would engage in intimate supplication with his Lord, he said, ‘My Lord, are you so far from me that I should call You, or are You so near to me that I should whisper? so Allah then revealed to Moses, ‘I sit in close proximity with the one who remembers Me.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَنِ اشتَغَلَ بذِكرِ اللّهِ طَيَّبَ اللّهُ ذِكرَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who occupies himself with the remembrance of Allah, Allah beautifies his remembrance [among people].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ذاكِرُ اللّهِ سبحانَهُ مُجالِسُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who remembers Allah, glory be to Him, is sitting closely with Him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَزالُ المُؤمنُ في صلاةٍ ما كانَ في ذِكرِ اللّهِ ، قائماً كانَ أو جالِساً أو مُضطَجِعاً ، إنّ اللّهَ تعالى يقولُ «اَلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللّهَ قِياماً وقُعُوداً وعَلَى جُنوبِهِم ...» .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘The believer remains in a state of prayer as long as he is remembering Allah, whether he is standing, sitting or lying down, for verily Allah says, “Those who remember Allah standing, sitting and lying on their sides”

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ الصاعِقَةَ لا تُصِيبُ ذاكِراً للّهِ عزّوجلّ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily the one who remembers Allah will never be struck by lightning.

_source.chapter: Remember Me and I Will Remember You
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قالَ اللّهُ تعالى: ابنَ آدمَ ، اُذكُرْني في نَفسِكَ أذكُركَ في نَفسي . ابنَ آدمَ اُذكُرني في الخَلاءِ أذكُركَ في خَلاءٍ . ابنَ آدمَ اُذكُرني في مَلاَءٍ أذكُرْكَ في مَلاَءٍ خَيرٍ مِن مَلَئِكَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Allah Almighty said, ‘O son of Adam, remember Me within yourself and I will remember you within Myself. O son of Adam, remember Me in secret and I will remember you when [you are] in secret. O son of Adam, remember Me when in an assembly and I will remember you in an assembly which is better than your assembly.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ذِكرُ اللّهِ شِفاءُ القُلوبِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The remembrance of Allah is a healing for the hearts.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أكثَرَ مِن ذِكرِ اللّهِ فقد بَرِئَ مِنَ النِّفاقِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The one who remembers Allah abundantly has freed himself from hypocrisy.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أكثَرَ ذِكرَ اللّهِ أحَبَّهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The one who remembers Allah abundantly loves Him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن عَمَرَ قَلبَهُ بدَوامِ الذِكرِ حَسُنَت أفعالُهُ في السِّرِّ والجَهرِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one whose heart thrives with the continuous remembrance of Allah, his actions will always be good whether done in secret or openly.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أصلُ صلاحِ القلبِ اشتِغالُهُ بذِكرِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The root of reforming the heart is in occupying it with the remembrance of Allah.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن ذَكَرَ اللّهَ سبحانَهُ أحيا اللّهُ قَلبَهُ ونَوَّرَ عَقلَهُ ولُبَّهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever remembers Allah, glory be to Him, Allah enlivens his heart and illuminates his intellect and the innermost core of his heart.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ذِكرُ اللّهِ قُوتُ النُّفوسِ ومُجالَسَةُ المَحبوبِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The remembrance of Allah is a provision for the souls and a close sitting in the company of the Beloved.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَليكَ بِذِكرِ اللّهِ ، فإنّهُ نورُ القلوبِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘I urge you to keep up the remembrance of Allah for verily it is the light of the hearts.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): دَوامُ الذِكرِ يُنيرُ القلبَ والفِكرَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Continuous remembrance [of Allah] enlightens the heart and the mind.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ اللّهَ سبحانَهُ جَعَلَ الذِّكَر جَلاءً للقُلوبِ ، تَسمَعُ بهِ بَعدَ الوَقْرَةِ ، و تُبصِرُ بهِ بَعدَ العَشْوَةِ ، وتَنقادُ بِهِ بَعدَ المُعانَدَةِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah, Glory be to Him, has made [His] remembrance a polish for the hearts through which they hear after deafness, see after blindness and yield after resistance.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في الدُّعاءِ ـ: يا مَنِ اسمُهُ دواءٌ وذِكرُهُ شِفاءٌ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in supplication, ‘O He whose name is a remedy and whose remembrance is a healing.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الذِّكرُ مِفتاحُ الاُنْسِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Remembrance [of Allah] is the key to intimacy (with Him).

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا رَأيتَ اللّهَ سُبحانَهُ يُؤنِسُكَ بِذِكرِهِ فقد أحَبَّكَ ، إذا رَأيتَ اللّهَ يُؤنِسُكَ بِخَلقِهِ ويوحِشُكَ مِن ذِكرِهِ فقد أبغَضَكَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘If you see that Allah, Glory be to Him, has made you intimate with His remembrance, then He loves you. If you see that Allah has made you intimate with His creation and banished you from His remembrance, then He has despised you.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ذِكرُ اللّهِ مَطرَدَةُ الشيطانِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The remembrance of Allah is a repellent of Satan.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ذِكرُ اللّهِ جَلاءُ الصُّدورِ وطُمأنِينَةُ القُلوبِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The remembrance of Allah is a polish for the breasts and a soothing for the hearts.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الذِّكرُ يَشرَحُ الصَّدرَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Remembrance [of Allah] expands the breasts.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Remembrance of Allah in Certain Situations: When Facing an Enemy
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا لَقِيتُم عَدُوَّكُم في الحَربِ فَأَقِلُّوا الكلامَ وأكثِرُوا ذِكرَ اللّهِ عزّوجلّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘When you face your enemy in battle, then lessen your speech and increase in the remembrance of Allah.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلى ذِكرِ اللّهِ في مَواقِفَ ـ عِندَ لِقاءِ العَدُوِّ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Remembrance of Allah in Certain Situations: When Entering the Market Place
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أكثِرُوا ذِكرَ اللّهِ عزّوجلّ إذا دَخَلتُمُ الأسواقَ عِندَ اشتِغالِ الناسِ، فإنّهُ كَفّارةٌ لِلذُّنوبِ وزِيادَةٌ في الحَسَناتِ ، ولاتُكتَبُوا في الغافِلينَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Increase in the remembrance of Allah when you enter the market while people are busy, for verily it will be an expiation of your sins and an increase in good deeds, and you will not be recorded down as being amongst the neglectful ones.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلى ذِكرِ اللّهِ في مَواقِفَ ـ عِند دُخولِ الأَسواقِ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Remembrance of Allah in Certain Situations: During Distress, When Giving Judgment and When Distributing
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اُذكُرِ اللّهَ عِندَ هَمِّكَ إذا هَمَمتَ، وعِندَ لِسانِكَ إذا حَكَمتَ ، وعِندَ يَدِكَ إذا قَسَمتَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Remember Allah during your distress when you are distressed, with your tongue when you give judgment and with your hand when distributing anything.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلى ذِكرِ اللّهِ في مَواقِفَ ـ عند الهَمِّ والحُكمِ والقِسمَةِ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Remembrance of Allah in Certain Situations: When in Anger
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أوحَى اللّهُ إلى نبيٍّ مِن أنبيائهِ: ابنَ آدَمَ ، اذكُرنِي عِندَ غَضَبِكَ أذكُرْكَ عِندَ غَضَبِي ، فلا أمحَقُكَ فيمَن أمحَقُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah revealed to a prophet from among His prophets, ‘O son of Adam, remember Me during your anger and I will remember you during My anger, and I will not destroy you as a result with those whom I destroy.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلى ذِكرِ اللّهِ في مَواقِفَ ـ عند الغَضَبِ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Remembrance of Allah in Certain Situations: When Alone and During Pleasures
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): في التَّوراةِ مَكتوبٌ: ... يا موسى ... اُذكُرْني في خَلَواتِكَ وعِندَ سُرورِ لَذَّتِكَ أذكُرْكَ عِندَ غَفَلاتِكَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘It is written in the Torah: ‘…O Moses… remember Me in times of loneliness and when enjoying your pleasures and I will remember you in your times of negligence.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلى ذِكرِ اللّهِ في مَواقِفَ ـ في الخَلَواتِ وعند اللَذّاتِ

_source.chapter: The Reality of the Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أطاعَ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ فَقَد ذَكَرَ اللّهَ وإن قَلَّتْ صلاتُهُ وصِيامُهُ وتلاوَتُهُ لِلقرآنِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever obeys Allah has remembered Him, even if his prayers, his fasts and his recitation of the Quran are few.

_source.chapter: The Reality of the Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قولِهِ تعالى: «ولَذِكْرُ اللّهِ أَكبَرُ»ـ: ذِكرُ اللّهِ تَعالى عِندَ ما أحَلَّ وحَرَّمَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, with regard to the verse of Allah: “and the remembrance of Allah is greater”, ‘[It means] Remembering Allah with regards to what He has made lawful and unlawful.

_source.chapter: The Reality of the Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الذِّكرُ ذِكرانِ: ذِكرٌ خالِصٌ يُوافِقُهُ القَلبُ ، وذِكرٌ صارِفٌ يَنفِي ذِكرَ غَيرِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘There are two types of remembrance, a sincere remembrance which is harmonious with the heart, and a mere remembrance which negates the remembrance of anyone other than Allah.

_source.chapter: The Reality of the Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِجعَلْ ذِكرَ اللّهِ مِن أجلِ ذِكرِهِ لكَ ، فإنّهُ ذَكَرَكَ وهُو غَنِيٌّ عنكَ فَذِكرُهُ لكَ أجَلُّ وأشهى وأتَمُّ مِن ذِكرِكَ لَهُ وأسبَقُ ... فَمَن أرادَ أن يَذكرَ اللّهَ تعالى فَلْيَعلَمْ أنَّهُ ما لَم يَذكُرِ اللّهُ العَبدَ بالتوفيقِ لِذِكرِهِ لا يَقدِرُ العَبدُ عَلى ذِكرِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Make your remembrance of Allah for the sake of the fact that He remembers you, for verily He remembers you even though He is needless of you, so His remembrance of you is loftier, more desirable and more complete than your remembrance of Him and it supersedes it…so whoever wishes to remember Allah, most High, should know that as long as Allah does not remember His servant in the context of granting him divine succour to remember Him [in the first place], the servant will not be capable of remembering Him.

_source.chapter: The Reality of the Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن ذَكَرَ اللّهَ ولم يَستَبِقْ إلى لِقائهِ فَقدِ استَهزَأ بنَفسِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘Whoever remembers Allah but does not vie to meet Him has mocked himself.

_source.chapter: That Which Brings About Continuous Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: في حديثِ المعراجِ: يا أحمَدُ ... دُمْ على ذِكرِي ، فقالَ: يا ربِّ ، وكيفَ أدُومُ على ذِكرِكَ ؟ فقالَ: بالخَلوَةِ عنِ الناسِ ، وبُغضِكَ الحُلوَ والحامِضَ ، وفَراغِ بَطنِكَ وبَيتِكَ مِنَ الدنيا.
_source.english: In the tradition recounting the Prophet (SAWA)s Ascension to the Heavens (al-miaraj): ‘O Ahmad… be continuous in My remembrance. The Prophet (SAWA) asked, ‘O My Lord, how can I be continuous in Your remembrance? He replied, ‘Through seclusion from people, despising the sweet and the sour [of the world], and clearing your stomach and your house of the world.

_source.chapter: That Which Brings About Continuous Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أحَبَّ شيئاً لَهِجَ بِذِكرِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever loves something is engaged in remembrance of it.

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَيسَ في المعاصِي أشَدُّ مِنِ اتِّباعِ الشَّهوَةِ ، فلا تُطِيعُوها فَتَشغَلَكُم عَنِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There is nothing worse from amongst the transgressions than submitting to ones base desires, so do not obey them as they will preoccupy you from [remembering] Allah.

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ ما ألهى عن ذِكرِ اللّهِ فهو مِن المَيسِرِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Anything that distracts you from the remembrance of Allah is classified as gambling.

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ ما ألهى عن ذِكرِ اللّهِ فهو مِن إبليسَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Anything that distracts you from the remembrance of Allah is from Iblis [Satan].

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ قَسوَةَ البِطنَةِ وفَترَةَ المَيلَةِ وسُكرَ الشِّبَعِ وغِرَّةَ المُلكِ مِمّا يُثَبِّطُ ويُبطِئُ عَنِ العَمَلِ ويُنسِي الذِّكرَ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘Verily filling the stomach, weakness of will, the intoxication of being fully satiated and the delusion of power, all hinder and delay one from the performance [of good deeds] and cause one to forget Allah.

_source.chapter: The Effects of Disregarding the Remembrance [of Allah]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن نَسِيَ اللّهَ سبحانَهُ أنساهُ اللّهُ نفسَهُ وأعمى قَلبَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever forgets Allah, Glory be to Him, Allah makes him forget himself and blinds his heart.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): خيرُ الذِّكرِ الخَفِيُّ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The best remembrance is the silent type.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ أو الإمامُ الصّادقُ: لايَكتُبُ المَلَكُ إلّا ما يَسمَعُ ، قالَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ: «وَاذْكُرْ رَبَّكَ في نَفسِكَ»: لا يَعلمُ ثوابَ ذلكَ الذِّكرِ في نَفسِ العَبدِ غيرُ اللّهِ تعالى.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir or Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The angel only writes down what he hears, but when Allah, Mighty and Exalted, has said, “And remember your Lord within your heart…”, no one knows the reward of that remembrance in the heart of the servant except Allah, most High.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): التَّوبةُ تَجُبُّ ما قَبلَها.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Repentance erases whatever precedes it.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): التّائبُ مِن الذَّنبِ كَمَنْ لا ذَنْبَ لَهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who repents for his sin is like one who has no sin.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): التَّوبَةُ تُطهِّرُ القُلوبَ وتَغْسِلُ الذُّنوبَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Repentance purifies the hearts and washes away the sins.

_source.chapter: The Status Of One Who Repents
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ليسَ شَيءٌ أحَبَّ إلى اللّهِ مِن مُؤمنٍ تائبٍ أو مُؤمنةٍ تائبةٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There is nothing more beloved to Allah than a penitent believer man or woman.

_source.chapter: The Status Of One Who Repents
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): كُلُّ بَني آدمَ خَطّاءٌ، وخَيرُ الخَطّائينَ التَّوّابونَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Every son of Adam is a sinner, but the best of the sinners are the penitent ones.

_source.chapter: The Status Of One Who Repents
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لَلّهُ أفْرَحُ بتَوبةِ عبدِهِ مِن العَقيمِ الوالِدِ، ومِن الضّالِّ الواجِدِ، ومِن الظّمآنِ الوارِدِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah rejoices for the repentance of His servant more than the barren rejoices for having a child, and more than the lost one who finds his way, and more than the thirsty one who finds water.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أمَّا عَلامةُ التّائبِ فأربَعةٌ: النَّصيحةُ للّهِ في عَمَلِهِ، وتَرْكُ الباطِلِ، ولُزومُ الحَقِّ، والحِرْصُ على الخَيرِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There are four signs to the penitent person: honesty in his work for the sake of Allah, avoiding misdeeds, adhering to what is right, and eagerness for what is good.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في وَصفِ التّائبينَ ـ : غَرَسُوا أشْجَارَ ذُنوبِهِم نُصْبَ عُيونِهِم وقُلوبِهِم وسَقَوها بمِياهِ النَّدَمِ، فأثْمَرَتْ لهُمُ السَّلامةَ، وأعْقَبَتْهُمُ الرِّضا والكَرامَةَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, describing the penitent ones, ‘They planted the trees of their sins before their eyes and hearts, and watered them with the water of remorse; thus they produced safety for them and left them with contentment and dignity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في مُناجاته ـ: واجْعَلْنا مِن الّذينَ ... قَطَعوا أسْتارَ نارِ الشَّهَواتِ بنَضْحِ ماءِ التَّوبَةِ، وغَسَلوا أوْعِيَةَ الجَهلِ بِصَفْوِ ماءِ الحَياةِ .
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said in his intimate supplication, ‘Place us among those … who extinguish the fire of desires by shedding the water of repentance, and wash the plates of ignorance with the purity of the water of life.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن اُعْطِيَ التَّوبَةَ لَم يُحرَمِ القَبولَ، ومَن اُعْطِيَ الاسْتِغْفارَ لَم يُحرَمِ المَغفِرَةَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A man who is blessed with repentance will not be deprived of its acceptance, and a man who is blessed with seeking forgiveness will not be deprived of forgiveness.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن تابَ قَبْلَ أنْ يُعايِنَ قَبِلَ اللّهُ تَوبَتَهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘A man who repents before he sees [the angel of death], Allah will accept his repentance.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا بَلَغتِ النّفسُ هذهِ ـ وأهْوى بيَدِهِ إلى حَلْقِهِ ـ لَم يَكُن للعالِمِ تَوبَةٌ، وكانتْ للجاهلِ تَوبَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘When the soul reaches this, and pointed at the back of his throat, there will not remain a chance to repent for the knowledgeable man, but there will remain a chance for the ignorant one.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد سُئلَ عن عِلّةِ إغْراقِ اللّهِ فِرْعَونَ وقد آمَنَ بهِ وأقَرَّ بتَوحيدِهِ ـ: لأنَّهُ آمنَ عندَ رُؤيةِ البَأْسِ، والإيمانُ عندَ رُؤيَةِ البَأْسِ غيرُ مَقبولٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS), when he was asked about the reason for Allahs drowning the Pharaoh after he believed in Him and attested to His oneness, replied, ‘Because he believed after he saw the wrath [of Allah], and belief at such a time is not accepted.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): النَّدَمُ تَوبَةٌ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Remorse is repentance.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): النَّدَمُ على الخَطيئةِ اسْتِغْفارٌ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Remorse for a sin counts as seeking forgiveness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): نَدمُ القلبِ يُكَفِّرُ الذَّنبَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Remorse of the heart offsets the sin.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عاصٍ يُقِرُّ بذَنبِهِ خَيرٌ مِن مُطيعٍ يَفتَخِرُ بعَملِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A sinner who confesses to his sin is better than an obedient man who brags about his deed.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): واللّهِ، ما يَنْجو مِن الذَّنْبِ إلّا مَن أقَرَّ بهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘By Allah! None will be safe from his sin except the one who admits it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا واللّهِ ما أرادَ اللّهُ تَعالى مِن النّاسِ إلّا خَصْلَتَينِ: أنْ يُقِرّوا لَهُ بالنِّعَمِ فيَزيدَهُم، وبالذُّنوبِ فَيَغفِرَها لَهُم.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘By Allah! Allah wants but two traits to be present in people: to acknowledge His favors so that He may increase them, and to confess their sins so that He may forgive them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): التَّوبَةُ على أربَعةِ دَعائِمَ: نَدَمٌ بالقَلبِ، واسْتِغفَارٌ باللِّسانِ، وعَملٌ بالجَوارِحِ، وعَزْمُ أنْ لا يَعودَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Repentance stands on four pillars: remorse with the heart, asking for forgiveness with the tongue, work with the limbs, and resolve not to repeat [the offense].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد سألَهُ شَيخٌ مِن النَّخَعِ: إنّي لَم أزَلْ والِياً مُنذُ زَمنِ الحَجّاجِ إلى يَومي هذا، فهَلْ لي مِن تَوبةٍ ؟ قالَ: فَسَكتَ، ثُمّ أعَدْتُ علَيهِ، فقالَ ـ: لا، حتّى تُؤَدّيَ إلى كُلِّ ذي حَقٍّ حقَّهُ.
_source.english: Wahab b. Abdu Rabbih narrated on the authority of a shaykh from [the tribe of] Nakhaa, who said, ‘I said to Abu Jaafar (AS), ‘I have been a governor since the time of al-Hajjaj until this very day - is repentance possible for me? He remained silent. When I repeated the question, he said, ‘No, until you compensate everyone for his lost rights.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أحْدِثْ لكُلِّ ذَنبٍ تَوبَةً ، السِّرُّ بالسِّرِّ والعَلانِيَةُ بالعَلانِيَةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Make a repentance for every sin; public [repentance] for public [sins] and private [repentance] for private [sins].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ وقد سُئلَ عنِ التَّوبةِ النَّصوحِ ـ: هُو النَّدمُ على الذّنبِ حينَ يَفْرُطُ مِنكَ، فتَسْتَغفِرُ اللّهَ بِنَدامَتِكَ عِند الحافِرِ، ثُمَّ لا تَعودُ إلَيهِ أبَداً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Sincere repentance is remorse for the sin as soon as it slips out from you; then you ask Allah for forgiveness, then you never return to it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الهاديُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد سُئلَ عنِ التّوبةِ النَّصُوحِ ـ: أنْ يَكونَ الباطِنُ كالظّاهِرِ وأفْضَلَ مِن ذلكَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Hadi (AS) when he was asked about sincere repentance, said, ‘ [It is] when the inner self becomes identical to the outer behavior, and even better than it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنْ قارَفْتَ سَيّئةً فعَجِّلْ مَحْوَها بالتَّوبةِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘If you commit a misdeed, hasten to erase it with repentance.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مُسَوِّفُ نَفسِهِ بالتَّوبةِ، مِن هُجومِ الأجَلِ على أعظَمِ الخَطَرِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who procrastinates in repenting for himself faces the greatest danger from the [sudden] attack of death.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الجوادُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تأخِيرُ التَّوبةِ اغْتِرارٌ ، وطُولُ التّسْويفِ حَيْرَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Jawad (AS) said, ‘Postponing repentance is an illusion, and long procrastination is perplexity.

_source.arabic: المسيح (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ مَن لَيس علَيهِ دَيْنٌ مِن النّاسِ أروَحُ وأقَلُّ هَمّاً مِمَّن علَيهِ الدَّينُ وإنْ أحسَنَ القَضاءَ، وكذلكَ مَن لَم يَعمَلِ الخَطيئةَ أرْوَحُ هَمّاً مِمَّن عَمِلَ الخَطيئَةَ وإنْ أخْلصَ التّوبَةَ وأنابَ.
_source.english: Prophet Jesus (AS) said, ‘The man who has no debt to people is more comfortable than the one indebted, even if he repayed his debt; and similarly the man who has not committed any sins is more comfortable than he who has committed sins, even if he has sincerely repented and returned (to the right path).

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَرْكُ الذَّنبِ أهْوَنُ مِن طَلبِ التَّوبةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Abandoning sin is easier than asking for forgiveness.

_source.chapter: Allah Conceals The Sin of The Penitent One
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن تابَ تابَ اللّهُ علَيهِ ، واُمِرَتْ جَوارِحُهُ أنْ تَسْتُرَ علَيهِ، وبِقاعُ الأرضِ أنْ تَكْتُمَ علَيهِ، واُنْسِيَتِ الحَفَظَةُ ما كانتْ تَكتُبُ علَيهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Allah turns mercifully to the one who repents, and his limbs are ordered to keep his secret, and all the places on earth to conceal for him [his sin], and the record-keeping angels to forget whatever they wrote about him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أوحى اللّهُ عزّ وجلّ إلى داوودَ النَّبيِّ على نبيّنا وآلهِ وعلَيهِ السّلامُ: يا داوودُ، إنّ عَبديَ المؤمنَ إذا أذْنَبَ ذَنبا ثُمّ رَجعَ وتابَ مِن ذلكَ الذَّنبِ واسْتَحيى مِنّي عندَ ذِكْرِهِ غَفَرْتُ لَهُ ، وأنسَيْتُهُ الحَفَظَةَ وأبْدَلْتُهُ الحسَنَةَ، ولا اُبالي وأنا أرْحَمُ الرّاحِمينَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrated, ‘Allah, the Exalted, revealed to Prophet David [Prophet David (AS) is known in the Arabic tradition as Dawud (ed.)] peace be upon him and on our Prophet, ‘O David! When My believing servant commits a sin and then returns [to Me and repents for that sin and is ashamed in My presence every time he remembers it, I will forgive him and cause the recording angels to forget it and change it to count as a good deed, and I will not care about it further, for I am the most Merciful.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): وَيْلٌ للمُتَألِّينَ من اُمَّتي، الَّذينَ يقولونَ: فُلانٌ في الجَنّةِ، وفُلانٌ في النّارِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Woe to those who foretell [about Allahs actions] from among my community, those who proclaim that 'so and so' will go to Paradise, but 'so and so' will go to the Fire.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ رجُلاً قالَ يوما: واللّهِ، لا يَغفِرُ اللّهُ لفُلانٍ! فقالَ اللّهُ عزّ وجلّ: مَنْ ذا الّذي تَأَلّى علَيَّ أنْ لاأغفِرَ لفُلانٍ؟! فإنِّي قد غَفَرتُ لِفُلانٍ، وأحْبَطْتُ عَملَ الثّاني بقولهِ: لا يَغفِرُ اللّهُ لفُلانٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘A man said one day, ‘I swear by Allah that He will not forgive so and so. Allah, the Exalted, said, ‘Who is he to foretell about what I will do, that I will not forgive this man? I indeed have forgiven him and annulled the work of the foretelling man because of his saying, ‘Allah will not forgive him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِقْدُ اَلْأمُ العُيوبِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Resentment is the basest of defects.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِقدُ مَثارُ الغَضَبِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Resentment is the instigator of anger.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِقدُ شِيمَةُ الحَسَدةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Resentment is the distinguishing characteristic of the jealous.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِقدُ نارٌ لا تُطْفَأُ إلّا بالظَّفَرِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Resentment is a fire that is only extinguished by triumph [over ones opponent].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : سَبَبُ الفِتَنِ الحِقْدُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Resentment is the cause of problems.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحَقودُ مُعذَّبُ النّفسِ ، مُتَضاعَفُ الهَمِّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The resentful person has a tormented soul and his anxiety is manifold.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا مَودَّةَ لِحَقودٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The resentful person knows no friendship.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الهاديُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : العِتابُ خَيرٌ مِن الحِقْدِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Hadi (AS) said, ‘Reproof [expressed] is better than resentment [harboured within].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ العسكريُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أقلُّ النّاسِ راحةً الحَقودُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Askari (AS) said, ‘Among people, the person with the least comfort is the resentful one.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : المؤمنُ يَحقِدُ مادامَ في مَجلسِهِ ، فإذا قامَ ذهبَ عنهُ الحِقدُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The believers resentment lasts as long as he is seated [in an assembly], but as soon as he rises it vanishes.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِتَّقُوا اللّهَ في عِبادِهِ وبِلادِهِ فإنّكُم مَسؤولُونَ حتّى عنِ البِقاعِ والبَهائمِ، أطِيعُوا اللّهَ ولا تَعصُوهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Be careful of your duty to Allah with respect to His people as well as His places, for verily you will be answerable even for the places [you frequented] and the animals. Obey Allah and do not disobey Him.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ألا كُلُّكُمْ راعٍ وكُلُّكُم مَسؤولٌ عن رَعِيَّتِهِ ، فالأمِيرُ الذي على الناسِ راعٍ وهُو مَسؤولٌ عن رَعِيَّتِهِ ، والرَّجُلُ راعٍ على أهلِ بَيتِهِ وهُو مَسؤولٌ عَنهُم ، والمَرأةُ راعِيَةٌ على بَيتِ بَعلِها ووُلْدِهِ وهِي مَسؤولَةٌ عَنهُم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Indeed each of you is a shepherd responsible for his own herd. The commander of the people is their shepherd and responsible for his herd, just as a man looks after his household and is responsible for them, and a woman tends to her husband and children and is responsible for them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ امرِئٍ مَسؤولٌ عمّا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُهُ وعِيالِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Every single person is answerable for all that he possesses and all who depend on him.

_source.chapter: The Answerability of the Hearing, the Sight and the Heart
_source.arabic: كتاب من لا يحضره الفقيه: قالَ رجلٌ للصّادِقِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ لي جِيرانا ولَهُم جَوارٍ يَتَغَنَّينَ ويَضرِبن بالعُودِ ، فرُبّما دَخَلتُ المَخرَجَ فَاُطِيلُ الجُلُوسَ استِماعا مِنّي لَهُنَّ؟... فقالَ لَهُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تاللّهِ أنتَ ! أما سَمِعتَ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ يقولُ: «إنَّ السَّمْعَ والبَصَرَ والفُؤادَ كُلُّ اُولئكَ كانَ عنه مَسْؤولاً»؟!
_source.english: It has been narrated in Man La Yahzuruhu al-Faqih that a man once came to Imam al-Sadiq (AS) saying, 'I have a neighbour whose slave girls sing and play the lute, and sometimes when I go to the outhouse I take my time there so I may listen to them…? So Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said to him, 'By Allah! Have you not heard the verse of Allah, Mighty and Exalted, [in the Qur'an], "Verily the hearing and the sight and the heart, each of those shall be answerable for it"?!

_source.arabic: لقمانُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لاِبنِهِ وهُوَ يَعِظُهُ ـ: يا بُنَيَّ، إن تَكُ في شَكٍّ مِنَ المَوتِ فَارفَعْ عَن نَفسِكَ النَّومَ ولَن تَستَطيعَ ذلكَ، وإن كُنتَ في شَكٍّ مِنَ البَعثِ فَارفَعْ عَن نَفسِكَ الانتِباهَ ولَن تَستَطيعَ ذلكَ.
_source.english: Luqman (AS) said to his son, exhorting him, ‘O my son, if you are in doubt about death, then try to avert yourself from falling asleep and you will not be able to, and if you are in doubt about the Resurrection, then try to avert yourself from waking up and you will not be able to do that either.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): المَعادُ مِضمارُ العَمَلِ، فمُغتَبِطٌ بِما احتَقَبَ غانِمٌ، ومُبتَئسٌ بِما فاتَهُ نادِمٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘(The Day of) Resurrection will be a field of activity wherein a successful man will be delighted at what he has bagged for himself, and a regretful man will grieve at what he has missed out on.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ مِن مَواعِظِهِ ـ: اِعلَمْ يَابنَ آدَمَ أنَّ مِن وَراءِ هذا أعظَمَ وأفظَعَ وأوجَعَ لِلقُلوبِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ، ذلكَ يَومٌ مَجموعٌ لَهُ النّاسُ وذلكَ يَومٌ مَشهودٌ، يَجمَعُ اللّهُ فيهِ الأوَّلينَ والآخِرينَ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said in one of his exhortations, ‘Know O son of Adam that beyond this [life] is something greater, more horrendous and more painful for the hearts. The Day of Resurrection. That is the day when people will be gathered and that will be an eventful day wherein Allah will gather people from the first to the last.

_source.chapter: The Drawing Near of the Hour
_source.arabic: الجعفريّات عن رسولِ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): بُعِثتُ أنا والسّاعَةُ كَهاتَينِ ـ وأشارَ بِإصبَعهِ: السَّبّابَةِ والوُسطى ثُمَّ قالَ ـ: وَالّذي نَفسِي بِيَدِه إنّي لَأجِدُ السّاعةَ بَينَ كِتفَيَّ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The time between when I was sent down [as a messenger] and the Hour is as these two, indicating to the space between his index finger and his middle finger. He then continued, ‘By the One who has my soul in His Grasp, verily I find the Hour to be upon me already.

_source.chapter: Allah s Exclusive Knowledge of the Hour
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قالَ عيسَى بنُ مَريَمَ لِجَبرَئيلَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَتى قِيامُ السّاعَةِ ؟ فَانتَفَضَ جَبرَئيلُ انتِفاضَةً اُغمِيَ عَلَيهِ مِنها، فلَمّا أفاقَ قالَ: يا روحَ اللّهِ، ما المَسؤولُ أعلَمُ بِها مِنَ السّائلِ، ولَهُ مَن فِي السَّماواتِ والأرضِ، لا تَأتيكُم إلّا بَغتَةً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrated, ‘Jesus son of Mary (AS) asked Gabriel (AS), ‘When will the Hour come upon which Gabriel started to tremble so severely that he fainted from it. When he came to his senses, he said, ‘O Spirit of Allah, the questioned one does not know that any more than the questioner does. To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth, and it [the Hour] will take you all by surprise.

_source.chapter: The Day of Rising [from the Graves]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أشَدُّ ساعاتِ ابنِ آدَمَ ثَلاثُ ساعاتٍ: السّاعَةُ الّتي يُعايِنُ فيها مَلَكَ المَوتِ، والسّاعَةُ الّتي يَقومُ فيها مِن قَبرِهِ، والسّاعَةُ الّتي يَقِفُ فيها بَينَ يَدَيِ اللّهِ تَبارَكَ وتَعالى .
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘Man s worst hours are three in number the hour wherein he will see the angel of death with his own eyes, the hour when he will rise up from his grave, and the hour when he will stand before Allah, Blessed and most High.

_source.chapter: The Description of the [Day of] Congregation
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يَموتُ الرَّجُلُ عَلى ما عاشَ عَلَيهِ، ويُحشَرُ عَلى ما ماتَ عَلَيهِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Man will die in the state that he has lived, and will be raised in the same state that he died.

_source.chapter: The Description of the [Day of] Congregation
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): كُلُّ مَن وَرَدَ القِيامَةَ عَطشانٌ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Everyone on the Day of Judgment will be thirsty.

_source.chapter: The Description of the [Day of] Congregation
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِسمَعْ يا ذَا الغَفلَةِ والتَّصريفِ مِن ذي الوَعظِ والتَّعريفِ، جُعِلَ يَومُ الحَشرِ يَومَ العَرضِ والسُّؤالِ والحِباءِ والنَّكالِ، يَومَ تُقلَبُ إلَيهِ أعمالُ الأنامِ، وتُحصى فيهِ جَميعُ الآثامِ، يَومَ تَذوبُ مِنَ النُّفوسِ أحداقُ عُيونِها، وتَضَعُ الحَوامِلُ ما في بُطونِها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Listen O negligent and fickle one to someone who exhorts and expounds. The Day of Resurrection has been made a day of exposition, questioning, bestowal and exemplary punishment. It is the day when men s deeds will be upturned, and all sins will be computed, when people s pupils will melt with grief and expectant women will deliver what they carry in their wombs.

_source.chapter: The Description of the [Day of] Congregation
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): وذلكَ يَومُ يَجمَعُ اللّهُ فيهِ الأوَّلينَ والآخِرينَ لِنِقاشِ الحِسابِ وجَزاءِ الأعمالِ، خُضوعاً قِياماً، قَد ألجَمَهُمُ العَرَقُ، ورَجَفَت بِهِمُ الأرضُ، فَأحسَنُهُم حالاً مَن وَجَدَ لِقَدَمَيهِ مَوضِعاً، ولِنَفَسِهِ مُتَّسَعاً!
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘And that is the day when Allah will gather all people from the first to the last, standing in subjugation in order to discuss the account [of their deeds] and the recompense for their actions. They will be bridled with their own sweat while the earth trembles under them. Those amongst them in the best state will be those who manage to find a stable place for their feet to stand and an open space for them to breathe!

_source.chapter: The Godwary People on the Day of Resurrection
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ في قولهِ تعالى: «يَومَ نَحشُرُ المُتَّقينَ إلَى الرَّحْمنِ وَفْداً» ـ: إنَّ الوَفدَ لا يَكونونَ إلّا رُكباناً، اُولئكَ رِجالٌ اتَّقَوا اللّهَ فأحَبَّهُمُ اللّهُ وَاختَصَّهُم ورَضِيَ أعمالَهُم، فسَمّاهُمُ المُتَّقينَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA), with regards to Allah s verse “The Day We shall gather the Godwary toward the All-beneficent, as incoming guests”[ Qur an 15], said, ‘Verily these incoming guests will only enter mounted. They are the men who were wary of their duty to Allah, so Allah loved them, distinguished them and is well-pleased with their deeds, and has therefore named them the Godwary.

_source.chapter: The Guilty Ones on the Day of Resurrection
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن لَقِيَ المُسلِمينَ بِوَجهَينِ ولِسانَينِ، جاءَ يَومَ القِيامَةِ ولَهُ لِسانانِ مِن نارٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who meets his fellow Muslims two-facedly and hypocritically [lit. having two-tongues] will be raised on the Day of Resurrection with two tongues of Fire.

_source.chapter: The Guilty Ones on the Day of Resurrection
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أكَلَ مِن مالِ أخيهِ ظُلما ولَم يَرُدَّهُ عَلَيهِ، أكَلَ جَذوَةً مِنَ النّارِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever wrongfully consumes his fellow brother s property and does not return it to him will be made to devour a burning log of fire on the Day of Resurrection.

_source.chapter: The Guilty Ones on the Day of Resurrection
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن قَرَأ القُرآنَ لِيَأكُلَ بِهِ النّاسَ جاءَ يَومَ القِيامَةِ ووَجهُه عَظمٌ لا لَحمَ فيهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever recites the Qur an in order to deceive people thereby will be raised on the Day of Resurrection with a bony face without any flesh therein.

_source.chapter: The Guilty Ones on the Day of Resurrection
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ المُتَكَبِّرينَ يُجعَلونَ في صُوَرِ الذَّرِّ يَتَوَطَّؤهُمُ النّاسُ حَتّى يَفرُغَ اللّهُ مِنَ الحِسابِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily the proud ones will be transformed into tiny particles that people will trample underfoot until Allah finishes the account.

_source.chapter: The Guilty Ones on the Day of Resurrection
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا كانَ يومَ القِيامَةِ نادى مُنادٍ: أينَ الصَّدودُ لِأولِيائي ؟ فيَقومُ قَومٌ لَيسَ عَلى وُجوهِهِم لَحمٌ، فيُقالُ: هؤلاءِ الّذينَ آذَوُا المُؤمِنينَ ونَصَبوا لَهُم وعانَدوهُم وعَنَّفوهُم في دِينِهِم، ثُمَّ يُؤمَرُ بِهِم إلى جَهَنَّمَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘When the Day of Resurrection comes, a caller will announce [on Allah s behalf], ‘Where are those who obstructed My friends and a group of people with no flesh on their faces will stand, and it will be said of them, ‘These are the people who troubled the believers, who declared enmity towards them, who opposed them and treated them harshly because of their religion. Then they will be ordered into Hell.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قَولِه تَعالى: «وَكُلَّ إنْسانٍ ألْزَمْناهُ طائرَهُ في عُنُقِه» ـ: يَقولُ: خَيرُهُ وشَرُّهُ مَعَهُ حَيثُ كانَ، لا يَستَطيعُ فِراقَهُ حَتّى يُعطى كِتابَهُ يَومَ القِيامَةِ بِما عَمِلَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS), with regards to Allah s verse “We have attached every person s omen to his neck”, said, ‘The good and the evil he has done is with him wherever he is, and he cannot separate them until he is given his book about his deeds on the Day of Resurrection.
